introduction: South Carolina 211 provides free, confidential resource referrals around the clock. Call, text or search the statewide directory.
description: South Carolina 211 provides free, confidential resource referrals around the clock. Call, text or search the statewide directory.

sections.who: Anyone can ask for information; referred programs set their own eligibility.
sections.get: Specialists connect callers with food, housing, utilities and other community resources.

sections.apply:
1. Contact 211

    Dial 211, text 211-211 or use the statewide directory link.

  2. Describe the problem

    Include your location and previous attempts to get help.

  3. Contact the referral

    Ask about available assistance and its application checklist.
sections.after: Return to 211 for alternatives when a provider cannot help.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using SC 211 contacts and service. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
